panels.title: Buildings menu
panels.html:
Buildings

A stone watchtower with a platform and battlements.

Enough resources to build.

A stone fortress with a platform and battlements. Its platform gives 75 % more sight.

Already built

A connectable stone wall. Drag to build a straight line; you can walk along the top between connected segments.

Enough resources to build.

A gate in the wall: people pass through it, and from it you climb up to the wall walk.

Enough resources to build.

An open workshop and material yard for Builders. Each workshop serves 4 Builders; Builders without one work 50 % slower.

Enough resources to build.

A quarry with three Miner workplaces. It must cover a real stone deposit and be reachable. It mines only its assigned finite deposit.

Enough resources to build.

A physical store with separate room for 200 raw inputs and 200 finished food units. Haulers serve every store in the kingdom.

Enough resources to build.

A farmhouse with three Farmer workplaces. Farmers tend crops within 15 tiles.

Requires: Build a Granary

Barracks with five places for existing residents. Soldiers patrol the surroundings.

Enough resources to build.

Wheat grows for two game days. A farmer must physically harvest the ripe crop for 8 Wheat.

Requires: Build a Farmhouse

Permanent fruit trees grow apples for three game days. A farmer harvests 6 Apple without replanting.

Requires: Build a Farmhouse

A hunting lodge for two Hunters. Hunters bring meat from real kills.

Requires: Build a Granary

A hut on the shore for two Fishers. It must stand next to water; Fishers fish from the shore and carry the catch to a Granary.

Requires: Build a Granary

Two Millers grind 4 Wheat into 3 Flour with 30 seconds of active work. Inputs and outputs are physically carried.

Enough resources to build.

Two Bakers turn 2 Flour into 4 Bread with 30 seconds of active work and physical deliveries.

Enough resources to build.

A physical store for 200 building materials. Haulers serve every store in the kingdom.

Enough resources to build.

A market square with stalls where merchant caravans will trade. Goods space for 80 units and 2 loading spots.

Requires: Build a Warehouse

A family home. Each completed House gives room for 5 more residents.

Enough resources to build.

A permanent cobbled surface: +25 % movement speed. 1 Stone for every 2 new tiles. Build single tiles, lines or whole courtyards.

Enough resources to build.

A stable with a fenced paddock for 4 tamed horses. Two Stablehands tame wild horses and lead them in.

Enough resources to build.

Two Wheelwrights build a Wheelbarrow (10 Wood, 2 Iron Bars, 30 s) or a Horse Wagon (30 Wood, 6 Iron Bars and a tamed horse from the Stables, 90 s). It is left beside the workshop for a Hauler to take.

Enough resources to build.

Three Woodcutters reserve mature trees within 18 tiles, physically chop and carry timber to existing storage.

Enough resources to build.

Three Miners work a single assigned Iron Deposit within four tiles of the footprint, then physically deliver raw Iron Ore to storage.

Enough resources to build.

A stone fire basin. It will light its surroundings once the game has nights.

Enough resources to build.

Two Smelter Operators turn 3 physically delivered Iron Ore and 2 Wood into 1 Iron Bar with 40 seconds of active work. Auto Production hires available unemployed residents by Smelting skill.

Enough resources to build.

Two Bowyers turn 8 physically delivered Wood into 1 Bow with 30 seconds of active work. Bows are carried to an Armory.

Enough resources to build.

Two Swordsmiths turn 3 Iron Bars and 2 Wood into 1 Sword with 45 seconds of active work. Swords are carried to an Armory.

Enough resources to build.

Two Armorers forge 5 Iron Bars and 2 Wood into 1 metal Armor with 60 seconds of active work. Armor is carried to an Armory.

Enough resources to build.

A guarded store for 40 Bows, Swords and Armor. Haulers bring finished equipment here; it takes nothing else.

Enough resources to build.

Browsers stop hidden tabs, so the missed time is caught up when you return (at most 15 minutes per absence). Stored in this browser only.

Developer
